setup_config_from_yaml: load a YAML config file using setup() to get a Config object with attribute-style access
create_AttrDict_with_nested_dicts: create an AttrDict from a dictionary to access nested keys via dot notation instead of bracket notation
use_Loader_with_include_directive: parse a YAML file that uses the !include directive to embed other YAML or text files
convert_AttrDict_to_yaml_dict: call the yaml() method on an AttrDict to convert it back to a plain dictionary
repr_Config_object: print a Config object to get a formatted multi-line string of all config keys and values
